name: Manhattan Institute
note: manhattan.institute/research is a 404 and the WordPress backend is headless (no /feed/ and no /wp-json). The only backfillable listing is the search service feed at search.manhattan.institute/mi/feed, which accepts page= and limit= (limit=500 works; 4 pages reach July 2024). Heavy national output: items carry <category>New York</category> / <category>New York City</category> when relevant, so the New York City filter can key off that or the full text.
auto_ingest_note: Its only backfillable feed is the search service, whose New York output is overwhelmingly New York Post and City Journal op-eds; reports are not distinguishable by URL, category or title.

name: Center for New York City Affairs at The New School
short_name: Center for New York City Affairs
note: Squarespace RSS returns only 20 items, which stops at Feb 2025 and misses the Jan-Feb 2025 tail. Squarespace accepts &offset=<epoch-ms> on the same feed and returns the 20 items published before that instant, so the crawl reads the feed twice: live, then pinned at 2025-03-01 (offset=1740787200000). Read through the html adapter because the rss adapter takes a single URL.

name: NYU Furman Center
note: furmancenter.org/research redirects to a single publication; the real listing is /publications/, but it renders only three slider cards server-side and loads the archive from wp-json/fur/v1, so there is nothing for an HTML pattern to match. The site's standard REST route for the 'publication' post type (wp-json/wp/v2/publication) returns the full archive, so this uses the wp-json adapter. Largely empirical housing research; many items will fail the recommendations bar. Include only items that make explicit recommendations.

name: Vital City
note: Ghost Content API. Journal essays and data pieces; include only those making explicit recommendations.
auto_ingest_note: An essay journal: the Ghost feed returns every piece, and reports are not distinguishable from commentary by any field.
